text: - An element is focusable if it holds a sub-document, or if it is not inert (by presence on itself or an ancestor element, `Node::is_inert`), is no disabled form control and either has `tabindex >= 0` or, with no tabindex, is an `<a>`/`<area>` with `href` or a `button`, `input`, `select`, `textarea`, `frame`, `iframe` or `summary` (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:732-764) — `disabled` read by its presence on a form control alone (`ElementData::is_disabled`: `can_be_disabled()` and the attribute present), any value, bare, `"false"` or `"true"`, so a `<div disabled tabindex=0>` takes focus; the Tab walk (`focus_next_node` / `focus_prev_node`), autofocus (a disabled form control or an inert candidate skipped) and `DioxusDocument::unkeyed_actionable` read it (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:514-518; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:733; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:563-580; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:677-718) — the presence reading ratified by the founder (2026-10-13, «По наличию (Рекомендую)», confirmed on the wrap's answer card on 2026-10-14 «Подтвердить (Рекомендую)», each by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label), its narrowing to form controls and the `inert` read ratified by the founder (2026-10-18); a known limit stands: HTML's focus fixup is not built, so a node that holds focus when it becomes inert keeps it until focus moves (tests/blitz-tests/tests/inert_subtree.rs:68-93; tests/blitz-tests/tests/inert_subtree.rs:144-194), its fix owned by a `.andromeda/residuals.md` line (target: next)

text: - A pointer click on a `button` (any type) or an `input` of type `submit`, `reset` or `button` focuses it through `generate_focus_events` / `set_focus_to`, then submits the form owner when it is a submit button, and ends the walk matched — since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness, in every document; before it a submit button submitted without breaking the walk and every other button fell through to the unmatched clear of focus, so an accepted click on one left no element focused (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-scrolling-box-bounds-and-hit/report.md); a disabled form control still stops the walk first, a disabled ancestor `div` not (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18), a click on a `select` focuses it through `generate_focus_events` / `set_focus_to`, clearing its typeahead and the document's text selection, a disabled select stopped by the walk's gate first so it neither focuses nor acts, while an option is not clicked (a driver `click` on one is refused `covered` — on the stand the flight booker's two options among them) (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:857-870; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_select.rs:172-198; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_select.rs:235-256), and a click on any other element is unchanged — a CRUD row or the list still clears focus; on the stand a click focuses each stand button and Tab continues from it, and after an accepted driver `click` on `fx-before` it reads `focused` and is the tree's focus, in both layout modes (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:909-921; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:984-1001; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:638-665; the restated `stand_act_obstructed`) — ratified by the founder (2026-10-13, «Клик даёт фокус (Рекомендую)», each by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness/report.md

text: - A focused single-choice `select` (no `multiple`) that is no disabled form control (`ElementData::is_disabled`) takes a pressed ArrowDown / ArrowUp to the next / previous enabled option and Home / End to the first / last enabled option (with none chosen, ArrowDown reads as Home and ArrowUp as End), and a character pressed with no Ctrl, Alt or Meta as typeahead — the first enabled option whose label starts with the text typed, compared in lower case, the text kept for one select until 1 s of the document's clock passes; every other key does nothing (Enter and Space open nothing, a released Space activates no select); each change marks the changed set, dispatches one `input` then one `change` carrying the select's value and asks for a redraw, a key that changes nothing firing none; a `multiple` select and an `optgroup`'s options are not modelled (a `multiple` select takes no key) and no popup is painted (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:108-113; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:165-200; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:248-269; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:271-297; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/select.rs:166-181; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/select.rs:183-193) — as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-20-select-by-id/report.md

- A pressed Enter whose target is the focused node, after the text-input and range arms, dispatches a Click on it when it is no disabled form control (`ElementData::is_disabled`; ratified by the founder (2026-10-18)) and is a `button`, a `summary`, an `input` of type `submit`, `reset` or `button`, or an `a` with `href`; a released Space — `handle_key_up`, KeyUp's first default action, routed by `events/mod.rs` — on the focused node dispatches the same Click for a `button`, a `summary`, or an `input` of type `submit`, `reset`, `button`, `checkbox` or `radio` that is not disabled — a `disabled` attribute on a `summary` or an `a` gating neither key, as HTML does; a link takes no Space, and a text input and a range input take neither key there; the Click is built from `Node::synthetic_click_event_data(modifiers)` and queued by the event driver, so the app's handlers (a Dioxus `onclick`) run, then the default action `handle_click` — since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness, in every document; SC 2.1.1 on the stand's buttons is met by measurement: Enter and Space on each focused stand button read as its click (16 rows, `counter-increment`, `flight-book` and `crud-create` changing the screen; the flight booker's `select#flight-type` takes no activation key), and through the driver `press enter` and `press space` on a Tab-focused `counter-increment` each name `counter-value` (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:114-119; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:124-144; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:202-217; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:219-233; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:235-245; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/mod.rs:12; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/mod.rs:229-230; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:155-211; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_keys.rs:131-165)

text: - A key-press focus check exists on the stand, in both layout modes: after a click on `crud-name` a `Key::Tab` press moves focus to `crud-surname` and Shift+Tab moves it back, the first Tab on a fresh boot focuses `back-btn`, nothing reads focused at boot or after a click on a heading, and each time exactly the focused control's snapshot node reads `focused` and it is the accessibility tree's focus (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot_state.rs:329-365) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-snapshot-state-fidelity/report.md

subject: keyboard-harness
text:
- A keyboard check runs on the stand in both layout modes, since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness: `stand_keyboard` walks each lean task's stated sequence (`tab_order`) forward and back with Tab and Shift+Tab, with wrap, the engine's focus, the snapshot's `focused` node and the tree's focus agreeing at every step — the engine's reading with the root element dropped, because `get_focussed_node_id` / `Harness::focused()` falls back to the root when nothing is focused and never reads `None` (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:656-659); Enter and Space on each focused stand button read as its click (16 rows) and keys that do not activate type or change nothing; fixture rows for the controls HTML gives the keys, a button disabled after it took focus taking no key and a button that is itself scrolled taking Enter as its own click; a click focusing each stand button with Tab continuing from it; a `disabled` attribute skipping a form control and not a `<div disabled tabindex=0>`; the CRUD list taking focus and its keys moving the selection; the Apple delete binding deleting on every OS; and an inert subtree skipped by Tab (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:125-153; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:155-211; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:498-577; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:638-665; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:677-718; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:720-780; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:782-799; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:815-842); its readers `tab_order` and `focused` live in the stand checks' shared module (tests/blitz-tests/tests/common/mod.rs:47-63; tests/blitz-tests/tests/common/mod.rs:93-113); through the driver `stand_act_keys` presses `enter` and `space` on a Tab-focused `counter-increment` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_keys.rs:131-165)
 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness/report.md; since 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions the walk is also asserted in two enabled states, each reached by keyboard alone (`enable_by_keyboard`) and walked in order against the shared table `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER` — the flight booker after the return flight is chosen on `select#flight-type` by ArrowDown, five stops: `back-btn`, `flight-type`, `flight-start`, `flight-return-date`, `flight-book` (its boot `tab_order` `back-btn` → `flight-type` → `flight-start` → `flight-book`); CRUD after a row is selected, eight: `back-btn`, `crud-filter`, `crud-list`, `crud-name`, `crud-surname`, `crud-create`, `crud-update`, `crud-delete` — every `controls(task)` id over `LeanTask::ALL` lies in `tab_order` ∪ `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER`, asserted as an empty set difference — the select alone standing in the tables, its two options taking no focus —, and Enter and Space on the controls enabled later give 4 rows (Keyboard handling above); `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER` lives in the shared module beside `tab_order` and `focused` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:213-247; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:311-342; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:398-416; tests/blitz-tests/tests/common/mod.rs:65-91 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions/report.md)

text: - A range-input key and click check runs in both layout modes, since 2026-10-13-range-input-interaction: `range_input_interaction` drives a 7-row keys table and a 5-row clicks table through the harness, one `input` per change and none on a no-change Home, the input focused after every click, a disabled range taking neither keys nor a click, and attribute writes re-seeding and re-sanitizing the value (tests/blitz-tests/tests/range_input_interaction.rs:117-139; tests/blitz-tests/tests/range_input_interaction.rs:151-179; tests/blitz-tests/tests/range_input_interaction.rs:240-262; tests/blitz-tests/tests/range_input_interaction.rs:268-302); on the stand `stand_act_range` moves the Timer slider through the driver by click and key, and after two Tabs an arrow step leaves it focused with its role `Slider`, its name and the forward focus sequence unchanged (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_range.rs:1-10) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-range-input-interaction/report.md

subject: keyboard-harness
text: - A select key and typeahead check runs in both layout modes: `select_interaction` (7 tests) drives a 14-row keys table and a 7-row typeahead table through the harness — one `input` and one `change` per change, none for no change, `has_changes` asserted per row — the typed text kept for one second of the document's clock, a disabled select taking no key and no click, and an app writing `selected` re-seeding the choice; and through the driver `stand_act_select` (5 tests) walks Tab `fx-before` → `fx-pick` → `fx-named` → `fx-after` → `fx-before`, the disabled `fx-off` skipped, equal before and after the choices, and chooses an option by a click then a key (tests/blitz-tests/tests/select_interaction.rs:189-214; tests/blitz-tests/tests/select_interaction.rs:228-249; tests/blitz-tests/tests/select_interaction.rs:251-280; tests/blitz-tests/tests/select_interaction.rs:282-312; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_select.rs:172-198; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_select.rs:200-233) — both in the `a11y` leg (§9), both three rounds in the `stand-repeat` leg, `stand_act_select` by its `stand_` prefix and `select_interaction` by the leg's named `--test` list (.github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:54-58)
